cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Here's the finished budget report. Just the title page: I've left room for contributions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The board meets in ten minutes. They need your figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. It's the discussion edition. They can supply their figures directly, without reading mine first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair wants a recommendation, not a discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll add 'Approve' beneath the title. Finished decision edition. We've eliminated the discussion entirely.

mechanism: Copied completion rituals let A recast unfinished work as an intentionally finished form.
confusable: Unlike avoiding work, A declares the current result complete; unlike mere bluff, A borrows a misunderstood cue.
comparison: Paid physical installation versus a public budget deadline.
seedUse: Use the loose shelves and empty report as incomplete-work pressures; replace the generic confident prefixes.
